name: orchestrator
description: /orchestrate turns this session into a Drove planner: Opus plans, delegates to Claude or Codex workers in herdr panes (each in its own worktree), and reviews, but never edits code. A thin layer over Drove (../src): run state, delivery, guard and wakes are Drove's.

orchestratorModel.title: Orchestrator model
orchestratorModel.description: Model id every main-thread request of an orchestrator session is sent to.

orchestratorEffort.title: Orchestrator effort floor
orchestratorEffort.description: An orchestrator's requests never go below this effort; a higher /effort you set is kept.

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Model id a new worker starts on.

promotedModel.title: Promotion model
promotedModel.description: Model id a worker moves to when the orchestrator promotes it.

workerEffort.title: Default worker effort
workerEffort.description: Effort a worker starts at when the orchestrator does not choose one.

maxWorkers.title: Worker panes without asking
maxWorkers.description: The run's pane budget: how many worker panes may be open at once before a new one needs your yes in a dialog.

effortRouting.title: Lower effort for routing turns
effortRouting.description: Run turns woken by a worker's question, block or promotion request at medium effort. Off until its effect on the prompt cache is measured.

droveEntry.title: Drove CLI entry
droveEntry.description: Path to drove's src/cli.ts. Empty: the src/cli.ts beside this mod's folder (drove/mod → drove/src/cli.ts).

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: The node (22.18 or newer) that runs Drove's CLI.
